supplyType.description: Nature of the supply for place-of-supply determination (VAT Directive title V): goods, a general service, immovable-property service (art. 47), an event activity (art. 54) or admission (art. 53), restaurant/catering (art. 55), short-term hire of a means of transport (art. 56) or telecom/broadcasting/electronic services (art. 58).

customerType.description: Whether the customer is a taxable person (business, B2B) or a non-taxable person (private, B2C); selects the applicable general place-of-supply rule (art. 44 vs art. 45).

goodsTransported.description: Whether the goods are dispatched/transported to the customer; selects art. 32 (place = dispatch origin) over art. 31 (place = goods location).

placeOfSupplyCountry.description: The Member State the directive deems the place of supply (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Must equal the directive-mandated location for the supply nature (arts. 31/32/44/45/47/53/54/55/56/58).

buyerCountryCode.description: Buyer country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for B2B general services (art. 44) and B2C TBE services (art. 58).

sellerCountryCode.description: Seller country (BT-40, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for B2C general services (art. 45).

goodsLocationCountry.description: Country where the goods are located at the time of supply (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for goods not dispatched/transported (art. 31).

dispatchOriginCountry.description: Country where dispatch/transport of the goods to the customer begins (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for transported goods (art. 32).

propertyCountry.description: Country where the immovable property is located (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply for property-connected services (art. 47).

eventCountry.description: Country where the event/cultural activity actually takes place (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply under arts. 53/54.

serviceCountry.description: Country where the service is physically carried out or the vehicle is put at the customer's disposal (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of supply under arts. 55/56.

continuousSupply.description: Whether the supply gives rise to successive statements of account or payments (art. 64), so the tax point falls on expiry of the period.

periodEndDate.description: End of the statement/payment period for a continuous supply (art. 64); the tax point must fall on or after this date.

prepaymentAmount.description: Amount of a payment on account received before the supply (art. 65); VAT becomes chargeable on receipt of this amount.

prepaymentReceiptDate.description: Date the prepayment was received (art. 65); the tax point must fall on or after this date.

taxableAmountReduction.description: Reduction of the taxable amount on cancellation, refusal, non-payment or price reduction after the supply (art. 90 bad-debt relief).

intraCommunityAcquisition.description: Whether this purchase is an intra-Community acquisition of goods (arts. 40/41/68); enables the ICA place / safety-net / tax-point checks.

acquisitionPlaceCountry.description: Member State the directive deems the place of the intra-Community acquisition (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); must equal the arrival country (art. 40).

arrivalCountry.description: Country where dispatch/transport of the acquired goods ends (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the place of the intra-Community acquisition (art. 40).

acquirerVatIdUsed.description: The VAT identification number under which the acquirer made the acquisition (art. 41 safety-net Member State).

taxedAtArrivalProven.description: Whether the acquirer proves the acquisition was taxed at the place of arrival, disapplying the art. 41 safety-net.

supplyDate.description: Date of the chargeable event for the acquisition (art. 68); anchors the 15th-of-following-month tax-point backstop.

invoiceNumber.description: Number of the received supplier invoice held by the taxable person (art. 178 deduction condition).

invoiceReference.description: Alternative reference to the received invoice held by the taxable person (art. 178 deduction condition).

deductible.description: Whether the input VAT on this purchase is deductible; enables the arts. 167/178 deduction-right checks.

outputVat.description: Total output VAT chargeable in the period (art. 250); the return states this to calculate the liability.

deductibleVat.description: Total deductible (input) VAT in the period (art. 250); the return states this to calculate the deductions.

amount.description: Net VAT payable/refundable for the period = outputVat - deductibleVat (art. 250).

periodEndDate.description: End of the tax period the return covers (art. 252); the filing deadline must fall within two months of it.

filingDeadline.description: Statutory deadline by which the return must be submitted (art. 252), no later than two months after the period end.

intraCommunitySupplies.description: Total value of exempt intra-Community supplies / art.-44 reverse-charge services reported in the period; triggers the recapitulative-statement obligation (arts. 262/138).

recapitulativeSubmitted.description: Whether the recapitulative statement (EC Sales List) covering the period's intra-Community supplies was submitted (arts. 262/138).

recapPeriodEndDate.description: End of the period the recapitulative statement covers (art. 263); the statement must be submitted within one month of it.

recapSubmittedDate.description: Date the recapitulative statement was submitted (art. 263), within one month of the recap period end.

recapTotal.description: Listed total value of the recapitulative statement (art. 264); reconciles to the reported intra-Community supplies.

recapLines.description: Recapitulative-statement lines (art. 264); each states a customer VAT identification number and the total value supplied to that customer in the period.

value.description: Total value of goods/services supplied to the customer in the period (art. 264).
